LESSON: WRITING 7.5.1 THE WRITING PROCESS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.5: Writing 7.5.1 The Writing Process
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 7.5.1 The Writing Process, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How does the writing help us improve the quality of our writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recognise signs of terms related to the theme for efficient writing,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 7.5.1 The Writing Process in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. outline the stages of the writing process,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 7.5.1 The Writing Process in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. create a composition, story or poem following the steps of the writing process,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 7.5.1 The Writing Process in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 7.5.1 The Writing Process together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Collaboration : Learners embraces teamwork as they work in pairs or groups

● Critical thinking and problem solving : Learners develop active listening or observing and communication skills as they

share factual composition pieces among groups

Values:
Respect:Is fostered as learners regard for self and others positively as they brainstorm on topics related to respect and develop

factual compositions on the same

scripting plays, songs and poems.
